title: Paxelz
description: Paxelz adds a simple tool called the "Paxel", a combination of a axe, shovel and pickaxe - all in one item.
body:
Description

This mod adds a variety of Paxels - tools that are axe, shovel and pickaxe in one - for all of vanilla minecraft's tool materials. ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1507585/description_ebd0ec7c-b468-48a4-9812-6cbd47e2df3f.png) The Paxels are accompanied by various upgrades that go hand in hand with the paxels abilities. ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1507585/description_df3a605d-80f5-4e3b-b4f2-cd62fdec5c29.png) - Vein Miner - 3x3 Area Mining - Energy (Replaces durability with Forge Energy) - Storage Link (Prevent items from dropping on the floor and instead make them go directly to a linked storage like a chest) These upgrades can easily be added by right-clicking them on the item. Paxels have different amounts of upgrade slots: - Wood/Stone: None - Copper/Iron: 1 - Diamond: 2 - Gold/Netherite: 3
